scope: Encrypted private request history in automatic account backup and same-ID recovery
limits: Disposable Edge profiles, synthetic wallet/provider responses and a loopback account service. No real financial operation.
Recovered accounts retain application payment restrictions; existing signatures retain their original cryptographic authority.
Provider updates are unverified observations. No settlement/refund proof, balance credit, complete liability recovery or key revocation is established.
Financial vaults, chat payment messages, balances, reservations, receiver permissions and executor submission journals are excluded.
Unknown asset metadata displays the original base-unit quantity and asset ID. Physical-device delivery, first-offline installation and hosted durability remain unverified.
retainedFailures: Normal sign-in originally returned no private requests despite a saved approval.
A standalone archive-validation guard removal was not detected because restoration independently validates it; removing both property-presence guards is detected.
A supported USDC request originally lost its visible quantity and asset label after offline recovery; a focused regression now verifies the exact base-unit fallback.
Earlier test fixtures needed the pinned generated offline proof dependencies; corrected test-only runtime files are retained outside the repository.

The commit gate initially required new footage for changed recorded-source fingerprints. Historical source revision checks preserve the existing footage without treating it as current feature evidence.
